**(a) Social posts**

3. If superintelligent AI arrives within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We need strong protections in place before that happens—not after.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We face a clear and urgent challenge. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. That means the systems people rely on every day—from power and water to communications and transport—could be under its control before we have time to respond. We cannot treat this as a distant concern or wait for a crisis to begin protecting the public. We need serious safeguards, accountable oversight and plans to defend essential services before superintelligent AI is built. In this newsletter, we’re setting out why the stakes are so high and what we can do now to keep critical infrastructure secure.
